text: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage has not been reported with Pentamidine Isethionate. The symptoms and signs of overdosage are not known. A serious overdosage, to the point of producing systemic drug levels similar to those following parenteral administration, would have the potential of producing similar types of serious systemic toxicity. (See PRECAUTIONS ). Available clinical pharmacology data (see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY ) suggest that a dose up to 40 times the recommended Pentamidine Isethionate dosage would be required to produce systemic levels similar to a single 4 mg/kg intravenous dose.
